ON THE 21 st OF APRIL, 2023  MISC. CRIMINAL CASE No. 10416 of 2023  BETWEEN:-
 RAJA S/O SANJEEV RAJBHAR, AGED ABOUT 20 YEARS,
 OCCUPATION:
LABOUR R/O KERPANI POLICE STATION  SUATALA,DISTRICT-NARSINGHPUR (MADHYA  PRADESH)

(BY SHRI G.P. PATEL - ADVOCATE )
 AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION SUATALA DISTRICT NARSINGHPUR (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI G.S. THAKUR - GOVT. ADVOCATE)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the C  the following:
 ORDER

This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of bail who is in custody since 10.11.2022 in connection with FIR No.520/2022 registered at Police Station Suatala, District-Narsinghpur, for the offence punishable under Sections 363,366,366 (ka), 376 (2)
(n) of IPC and Sections 5/6 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: As per prosecution, the missing person report was lodged by father of the prosecutrix that his daughter who is 17 years of age was missing since the night of 31.10.2022.
The girl was recovered from the possession of present applicant on 10.11.2022.
In her 164 Cr.P.C.statement, the prosecutrix has stated against the present applicant.
However, in her Court statement she has retracted her earlier statement and stated that she has left her parental house on her own.
She has even denied knowing the applicant.
Similar is the statement of the parents of the prosecutrix.

sentences.text: The contention of learned counsel for the applicant is that the prosecutrix was major and having love affair with the applicant.
She was a consenting party all along.

Referring to the Dakhila Kharij Register, it is stated that the same mentioned that the age of the prosecutrix was recorded according to her father's statement, and no document or birth certificate was submitted at that time.
It is submitted that under such circumstances, the applicant is entitled to be enlarged on bail.
Learned GA, on the other hand, has opposed the bail application.
It is pointed out that the FSL report has come positive against the applicant.

However, considering the age of the prosecutrix that she is 17 plus, and as per her own statement she has left the house as per her will, without adverting to the merits of the case, this application is allowed.

I t is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/committal Court for his appearance on the dates given by the concerned Court.

It is further directed that the applicant shall also comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
Certified copy as per rules.

(NANDITA DUBEY) JUDGE jk Raja vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/147159829/
